name: math-tactical-classroom-v60-combined-factorization
author: Juan Diego Pérez
description: Offline Math Tactical classroom Windows installer centered on combined factorization cases, with mathematically verified multi-stage questions, strict four-choice option objects, runtime DOM integrity guards, 90-second questions, a 45-minute mission, PIN-protected Teacher Mode, the V60.7 Mastery boss, permanent boss-room weapons, and encrypted local results.

scripts.prepare: node scripts/prepare-classroom-v60.js && node scripts/patch-v60-factorization-workshop.js && node scripts/unpack-v61-boss-patch.js && node scripts/patch-v60-boss-v61.js && node scripts/patch-v60-teacher-mode-v604-runner.js scripts/patch-v60-teacher-mode-v604.js && node scripts/run-v605-relentless-patch.js && node scripts/unpack-v606-fair-dodge-patch.js && node scripts/patch-v60-fair-dodge-boss-v606.js && node scripts/unpack-v607-mastery-patch.js && node scripts/patch-v60-mastery-boss-v607.js && node scripts/patch-v60-math-verification-v6071.js && node scripts/patch-v60-combined-factorization-v608.js && npm run prepare:icons
scripts.test: npm run prepare && node --check school-game/v60/main.js && node --check school-game/v60/preload.js && node --check school-game/v60/game.js && node scripts/math-factorization-v608-combined-static-test.js && node scripts/audit-factorization-bank-v608.js
scripts.dist:win: npm run prepare && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.dir:win: npm run prepare && electron-builder --win dir --x64 --publish never

build.productName: Math Tactical Classroom V60.8 Combined Factorization

nsis.shortcutName: Math Tactical Classroom V60.8 Combined Factorization
